tenderSchedule.title: Providing Catering Service to Forest Academy Dharwad
tenderSchedule.description: Providing Catering Service to Forest Academy Dharwad

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Karnataka Forest Academy, Garag Road, Gungaragatti, Dharwad-580011

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Annual Turnover Certificate of last 3 financial years duly certified by a Chartered Accountant

Bidders shall submit a valid experience certificate supported by relevant documentary evidence demonstrating their proven capability and prior experience in providing catering services to a minimum of 10000 persons per day
Bidders shall submit a valid Food Safety and Food Security Certificate issued by the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India FSSAI
Bidders shall submit a valid Forest Contractor Registration Certificate for FY 2026 27 issued by Joint Director KFA Dharwad

Bidders shall submit details of the manufacturers and suppliers of utensils and cooking equipment required for bulk food preparation and serving along with relevant supporting certificates and documentary evidence

Bidders shall submit documentary evidence demonstrating a minimum of 3 years of experience in food preparation and catering services along with audited financial statements or a Chartered Accountants certificate confirming an annual turnover of not less than Rs. 50.00 Lakhs

Bidders shall submit documentary evidence of having provided catering services to Government Departments or large organizations during the preceding three years Preference shall be given to bidders having prior experience in providing such services within Dharwad District
The bidder shall submit a self attested copy of the Permanent Account Number PAN Card issued by the Income Tax Department as documentary evidence
The bidder shall submit a valid Goods and Services Tax GST Registration Certificate issued by the competent authority as documentary evidence of GST registration
The bidder shall submit copies of the last 3years Income Tax Returns
